title: Deer Park Delhi - Attractions, Timings & Travel Guide
content:
Deer Park - Delhi,

Deer Park in Delhi is one of the city’s most peaceful and green getaways. Located in Hauz Khas, it is popular for its lush landscapes, serene lakes, and herds of deer that roam freely in the enclosures. The park is a favorite for morning walks, birdwatching, picnics, and photography, making it one of the best places in Delhi to connect with nature.

History:

The Deer Park, also known as Aditya Nath Jha Deer Park, was established to preserve green spaces in the city and provide a natural habitat for animals and birds. It is closely linked to the Hauz Khas complex, adding both ecological and historical charm to the area.

Attractions at Deer Park:

  • Deer Enclosures – Watch spotted deer and other animals in their natural surroundings.
  • Hauz Khas Lake – A peaceful water body with migratory birds, making it ideal for birdwatching.
  • Walking & Jogging Trails – Long, shaded paths perfect for fitness enthusiasts and nature lovers.
  • Picnic Spots – Green lawns where families and friends relax on weekends.
  • Historical Monuments – The park connects to Hauz Khas Fort and other medieval structures.

Visitor Information:

  • Location: Hauz Khas Village, South Delhi.
  • Timings: 5:00 AM – 8:00 PM (summer); 5:30 AM – 7:00 PM (winter).
  • Entry Fee: Free
  • Parking: Limited parking available near Hauz Khas Village and Hauz Khas District Park.

How to Reach:

  • By Metro: Nearest metro station is Green Park Metro Station (Yellow Line), around 2 km away.
  • By Bus: Regular DTC buses stop near Hauz Khas and Green Park.
  • By Car/Taxi: Easily accessible by cab, auto, or personal vehicle.

Best Time to Visit: You can visit Deer Park any time of the year, but the best season is October to March when the weather is pleasant for outdoor walks and picnics. Early mornings and evenings are the most peaceful times to visit.

Nearby Attractions:

  • Hauz Khas Fort & Village (1 km).
  • Rose Garden (adjacent to the park).
  • Safdarjung Tomb (5 km).
  • Lodhi Gardens (6 km).

Travel Tip: If you love photography, carry a zoom lens for capturing deer, birds, and the scenic lake views.
excerpt: The Deer Park in Delhi is a peaceful urban escape where nature, history, and wildlife come together. With its deer enclosures, lakes, and walking paths, it’s a perfect spot for morning walks, birdwatching, and family outings.
